svg.aria-label: Faraday’s disk spins in a steady field and makes a steady EMF although the flux through the circuit never changes; two rocking plates change the flux through the current path a lot yet make almost no EMF
svg.text: Two cases where "count the flux" misleads; the force on the charges never does

text.tspan: Faraday paradox — the homopolar disk and the rocking plates
